tools.name: Mind Freeze
limitations: Fifteen-yard range
Fifteen-second cooldown before Coldthirst
Single target

tools.name: Death Grip
limitations: Pulls a susceptible enemy to the Death Knight
Does not provide a spell-school lockout

tools.name: Chains of Ice
limitations: Movement slow only unless Ice Prison is selected
Costs one Rune

tools.name: Blinding Sleet
limitations: Damage can break the disorient
Only affects susceptible enemies

tools.name: Control Undead
limitations: Undead enemies only
Controlled enemy becomes a temporary pet for five minutes

tools.name: Raise Ally
limitations: Requires a dead ally
Costs Runic Power
Uses the shared combat-resurrection limit

tools.name: Anti-Magic Zone
limitations: Reduces magical damage only
Allies must remain inside the stationary zone
Does not stack with another Anti-Magic Zone

tools.name: Anti-Magic Shell
limitations: Personal magic absorb and debuff prevention only
Does not remove existing effects without Unyielding Will

tools.name: Death's Advance
limitations: Personal forced-movement and knockback immunity while active
Does not remove an existing root

tools.name: Wraith Walk
limitations: Personal root removal and movement only
Taking another action cancels the channel

tools.name: Icebound Fortitude
limitations: Personal mitigation and stun immunity only

provenance.description: Current Midnight Frost guide identifies Raise Ally, Death Grip, Anti-Magic Shell, Mind Freeze, control talents, Anti-Magic Zone, and Icebound Fortitude.
Current Death Grip record identifies the displacement spell and confirms its spell identifier.
Current Anti-Magic Zone record confirms party or raid protection against spell damage.
Current Frost Mythic+ guide identifies dungeon-specific Death's Advance and Wraith Walk interactions.
Current Wraith Walk record confirms root removal and channel cancellation on another action.
